slides.title: YOUR MISSION: BREAK THE BARRIERS!

items.title: THEORY
items.text: Master words like Relativity and Prototype.

items.title: EXPERIENCE
items.text: Listen to the performance of the play script.

items.title: TRACKING
items.text: Follow character actions to solve the mystery.

slides.notes: Brief the students on the three main goals for this reading block.

slides.title: THE FATHER OF SCI-FI
slides.subtitle: Before we time travel, let's meet the man who invented the machine.

slides.title: H.G. WELLS | The Man Who Saw Tomorrow
slides.content:
Name: Herbert George Wells
Born: 1866 (England)
Famous For: Inventing modern Science Fiction.
Big Ideas: He predicted space travel, atomic bombs, and the internet long before they happened.

slides.title: STRATEGY | Scanning for Facts
slides.content:
⌘WHAT: Find specific dates and names quickly.
⚡WHY: To answer questions without reading every single word.
👈HOW: Move your eyes fast! Do not stop to read sentences. Look for Capital Letters and Numbers.

slides.title: TASK 1 | Who is H.G. Wells?
slides.content:
Scan SECTION 1 to answer:
1. When was the novel published?1895
2. What idea did it make popular?Time Travel Machine
3. Who is the other 'father' of Sci-Fi?Jules Verne

slides.title: TASK 1 CHECK | Novel Date
slides.explanation: This was the year H.G. Wells changed Science Fiction forever.

slides.title: TASK 1 CHECK | Big Idea
slides.explanation: While others wrote about the future, Wells was the first to use a 'machine' to get there.

slides.title: TASK 1 CHECK | The Other 'Father'
slides.explanation: Wells and Verne are the two giants of early Science Fiction.

slides.title: ENTERING THE MACHINE
slides.subtitle: Grab your scripts! We're heading into the basement to witness a miracle.

slides.title: EXPERIENCE | The Play Script
slides.instruction: Sit back and follow the text as we listen to the performance.

slides.title: STRATEGY | True, False, or Not Mentioned?
slides.content:
TRUE: The text says exactly this (or uses synonyms).
FALSE: The text says the opposite or something different.
NOT MENTIONED: The text doesn't say anything about this at all.

slides.title: TASK 2 | Detail Check
slides.content:
1. Dan's friends visit him for dinner every couple of weeks.FALSE
2. Dan and his friends have to design a product related to time...FALSE
3. When Dan shows his design, his friends have mixed reactions...TRUE
4. Dan completed a model of his machine before building the real one.TRUE
5. When the friends next visit, he tells them about his adventures...NOT MENTIONED

slides.title: TASK 2 | Question 1
slides.evidence: [Para 1] 'we love meeting here for pizza and to hang out every week.'
slides.explanation: The text says 'every week', not 'every couple of weeks'.

slides.title: TASK 2 | Question 2
slides.explanation: There is no mention of a 'time' requirement for everyone, and it's implied they choose their own projects.

slides.title: TASK 2 | Question 3
slides.explanation: The group has mixed reactions to his invention.

slides.title: TASK 2 | Question 4
slides.evidence: [Para 2] 'Here's the design prototype... I'm building a full-sized time machine over there.'
slides.explanation: He built the small one (prototype) first.

slides.title: TASK 2 | Question 5
slides.evidence: [Para 4] The text ends as he says 'I'll tell you my story'.
slides.explanation: We don't know if he *actually* tells them, or if the scene cuts, or what happens next.

slides.title: CASE FILES
slides.subtitle: Let's track the characters. Who said what? Who felt what?

slides.title: STRATEGY | Tracking Speakers
slides.content:
🗣️WHAT: Identifying which character said specific lines.
📜WHY: To understand their personalities and feelings.
👈HOW: Look at the Bold Name before the dialogue line.

slides.title: TASK 3 | Character Recall
slides.content:
1.Who has a vague idea about his design?Mother
2.Who is the most critical/negative?Kai
3.Who notices the clock moving?Jasmine
4.Who is very serious about the future?Dan
5.Who breaks the bad news?Maya

slides.title: TASK 3 CHECK | Character Order
slides.evidence: [Para 1] Mother ('I think...'), Kai ('Useful?'), Jasmine ('Look!'), Dan ('Serious'), Maya ('Gone').
slides.explanation: Each character has a distinct role: The Skeptic (Kai), The Believer (Jasmine), The Observer (Maya).

slides.title: TIMELINE LOGIC
slides.subtitle: Can you put the story back in order?

slides.title: TASK 4 | Match the Scene
slides.instruction: Can you match the action to the correct scene?

slides.title: TASK 4 CHECK | Timeline Sequence
slides.evidence: [Page 4] Scene Headers match the action summaries.
slides.explanation: The story moves from the Living Room -> Basement -> Upstairs -> Return.

slides.title: THE VERDICT
slides.subtitle: Dan risked his life to travel time. Was it worth it?

slides.title: DEBATE | Brave or Foolish?
slides.content:
What do you think of Dan's actions?
BRAVE PIONEER
He pushed science forward. Risks are necessary for progress.		RECKLESS FOOL
He worried his mother and friends. He could have died for nothing.
03:00
slides.notes: Encourage students to use words like 'Innovation', 'Risk', 'Responsibility'.
